components.name: Hero link
components.description: Scrolls from the hero to the product list.
components.css: .ds-hero-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--color-ink-inverse, #f4f4f4); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; transition: opacity 150ms linear, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-hero-link:hover, .ds-hero-link:focus-visible { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-hero-link:active { opacity: 0.65; } .ds-hero-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero-link:hover, .ds-hero-link:focus-visible, .ds-hero-link:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Visit link
components.description: Opens the product on its own subdomain.
components.css: .ds-visit { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--color-ink, #141414); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-visit-action { display: inline-block; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 150ms linear; } .ds-visit:hover .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:focus-visible .ds-visit-action { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-visit:active .ds-visit-action { transform: translateX(1px); opacity: 0.65; } .ds-visit-domain { color: var(--color-secondary, #454545); font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; } .ds-visit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-visit:hover .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:focus-visible .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:active .ds-visit-action { transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The first screen is a night field. Codewizard’s name sits in white on the left. On the right, a sphere of points and short links turns slowly, like a planet drawn as a network. Depth is only size and opacity. Nothing else moves on arrival.

Under that, the page returns to paper. Products are a list, not a grid of tiles. Chartwizard is the entry that is actually published: platform, market, price, and the link to its subdomain, in the same block. The footer is one copyright line. There is no contact block yet.

The palette is black, white, and gray. Corners stay square. Schibsted Grotesk does every job.
keyCharacteristics: A full-viewport monochrome hero, then a paper product list
One wireframe globe, slow, paused off-screen and when the tab is hidden
White type on night, carbon type on paper
Square corners, hairline rules, one type family

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a hue. Gray is the only secondary tone. A link is underlined, not recolored.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Do not add a serif or a monospace costume.

rules.name: The Flat Row Rule
rules.body: Hover washes the row. It does not raise it.

dos: Do add a product in `products.js` and mirror the article in `index.html`.
Do keep the globe monochrome, slow, and out of the product list.
Do keep hero type off the sphere, especially on a phone.
Do leave the footer as a copyright line until a contact block is asked for.
donts: Don't add a colored accent, a gradient fill, or a glow on the globe.
Don't put the product list on the night field.
Don't hide the hero sentence behind the animation or behind a failed script.
Don't invent products, prices, or screenshots.
Don't imply this studio is CODE WIZARD INC or Code Wiz.
